verdict: Ford's revenue slipped 2% to $49.5B, but a stronger finance arm and cost work kept profit at $2.0B even as its electric-vehicle unit lost another $1.1B.

segments.name: Ford Blue
segments.note: Gas and hybrid cars and trucks — revenue down 3% as it sold 10% fewer vehicles.

segments.name: Ford Pro
segments.note: Vans, trucks and services for businesses — revenue up 2%.

segments.name: Ford Credit
segments.note: Loans and leases for car buyers — the finance arm.

segments.name: Ford Model e
segments.note: Electric vehicles — revenue down 31% on 31% fewer vehicles sold.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Small other external revenue in the segment note.

opex.name: Selling, administrative & other
opex.note: Selling cars and running the company day to day.

opex.name: Ford Credit interest & operating costs
opex.note: The finance arm's funding interest and running costs.

otherDetail: Other income of $922M, less $385M of interest on company debt (excluding Ford Credit), plus $155M of equity earnings from affiliated companies.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $0.60 a year ago; adjusted EPS $0.49

kpis.label: Adjusted free cash flow
kpis.note: cash left after building the business

takeaways.title: Pro is the profit engine
takeaways.text: Ford Pro, the business-vehicle unit, made $1,665M of EBIT (earnings before interest and tax) on $17.8B of revenue — more than the gas-vehicle unit — though profit fell 16% on commodity and launch costs.

takeaways.title: EVs still lose money
takeaways.text: Ford Model e lost $1,058M in the quarter. The loss narrowed 25% from a year ago, but on much lower sales — Ford is spending on a new, cheaper EV platform while first-generation models shrink.

takeaways.title: The bank inside Ford earned more
takeaways.text: Ford Credit's earnings before tax rose 27% to $803M on healthy lending margins and strong used-car prices, cushioning the vehicle businesses.

oneTimers: Ford's adjusted figures exclude $127M of pre-tax special items in the quarter; GAAP net income was $2,049M versus adjusted net income of $1,978M.
Ford raised the low end of its full-year adjusted EBIT guidance to $10.5-$11B (from $10-$11B).

sources.label: Form 10-Q segment note (SEC EDGAR, via Q4 CDN copy)

footerNote: Segment revenues are external revenues from Ford's 10-Q segment note (Ford Blue, Model e, Pro, Credit and $8M other), which sum to total revenue. Cost of revenue is Ford's reported cost of sales.
